initial.title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-05] External / third-party review
initial.goal: Produce one retained independent external review report for the unchanged final v0.92.1 candidate.
initial.required_outcome: Reviewer independence, complete declared scope, exact revision, findings, and limitations validate without candidate drift.
authority_boundary: Issue #521 owns only the independent review report
#520 supplies the internal register and unchanged candidate
External review does not approve release
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Do not execute before #520 reviewed merge
Use a reviewer independent of implementation and internal synthesis
Do not mutate candidate or product code
initial.task_boundary: Issue completion is exactly one independent external-review report; findings are rows within that report.
deliverables: Independent reviewer identity and conflict declaration
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Reviewer independence and conflicts are recorded
AC-2: Scope and limitations bind the unchanged exact candidate and #520 packet
AC-3: Every finding has severity, exact evidence, impact, and disposition route
AC-4: Missing or inaccessible evidence is a limitation or finding, never an implied pass
dependencies: TAIL-04/#520 reviewed green merge is live and candidate identity is unchanged
initial.plan_summary: Verify #520 and candidate identity, construct a context-complete external handoff, obtain independent findings-first review, reconcile findings without suppressing limitations, and validate the retained report.

steps.action: Verify #520 reviewed merge and unchanged candidate identity.
Build the reviewer handoff with complete scope, evidence index, non-claims, and limitations.
Obtain independent findings-first external review without candidate mutation.
Retain and validate the report, raw findings, limitation register, identity, and digests.

invariants: External review does not approve release
risks: Candidate drift may stale the report
External findings may be accidentally summarized away

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate reviewer independence, candidate identity, scope coverage, findings, and limitations.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Validator and report are #521 execution deliverables.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on dependency, independence, scope, candidate, evidence, limitation, or digest drift.
review_prompts: Does the report bind the exact unchanged candidate and complete #520 handoff?
Are findings and limitations retained without suppression?
initial.review_scope: Independent review of the exact v0.92.1 candidate and retained #520 internal-review packet.
